from pathlib import Path
p=Path('programs/task-c9246104.py'); s=p.read_text(); s=s[:s.index('from collections')] + '''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=grid[0][0]; out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Each outlined rectangle is a separate example. Fill its blank interior
    # with 7, irrespective of whether its outline has a hole or complete sides.
    for color in set(v for row in grid for v in row)-{bg}:
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==color]
        if len(pts)<4: continue
        r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
        c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
        if r1-r0<2 or c1-c0<2: continue
        # sides must have sufficient matching outline cells: rectangle-like frame
        sides=[sum(grid[r0][c]==color for c in range(c0,c1+1)),sum(grid[r1][c]==color for c in range(c0,c1+1)),sum(grid[r][c0]==color for r in range(r0,r1+1)),sum(grid[r][c1]==color for r in range(r0,r1+1))]
        if min(sides)<2: continue
        for r in range(r0+1,r1):
            for c in range(c0+1,c1):
                if grid[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=7
    return out
'''; p.write_text(s)
